problem: Residents often need quick help for small home repairs (plumbing, electrical, carpentry) but lack a trusted local platform to post requests and find nearby handypeople, leading to reliance on costly services or unreliable word‑of‑mouth referrals.
solution: A lightweight, offline‑first web board where users can post repair requests, specify skills they offer, and match locally without any backend. All data stays in the browser via localStorage, ensuring privacy and zero hosting cost.

competitors.name: Nextdoor
competitors.difference: Broad social network; no focused repair‑request board, requires account and ads

competitors.name: TaskRabbit
competitors.difference: Paid service connecting to freelancers; no free local board and incurs fees

features: Post a repair request with title, description, and needed skill
Offer a skill to help others
Persist data locally so board survives page reloads
Responsive design for mobile and desktop

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a premium badge for verified handypeople for $2/month; basic usage remains free
monetization.free_tier: Unlimited posting and browsing for all users

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free-tier limits
launch_strategy: Create a simple landing page on GitHub Pages and share the link in local community newsletters and social groups
Gather feedback from first 20 users to refine UI and add optional premium badge feature
potential_customers: HOA boards looking for a free tool

marketing_content.tagline: Fix it fast, locally – post or help with a click.
marketing_content.social_post: Introducing Neighbourhood Repair Board – a free, privacy‑first place to post small home‑repair needs and find trusted neighbours to help. No sign‑up, no fees. Try it today: https://yourusername.github.io/neighbourhood-repair-board

tests: Add a new repair request → it appears at the top of the list and persists after page reload
Apply a skill filter → only requests needing that skill remain visible
Delete a request → it disappears and does not reappear on reload
next_improvements: Add optional export/import of board data as JSON for sharing between devices
Implement a simple rating system for helpers
Allow anonymous posting with a simple captcha to reduce spam
